basis: Developmental impairment, contractures and characteristic skin/hair findings define the syndrome; myopia 5/6, optic/retinal atrophy and coloboma 30-79%.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: defining forehead nevus flammeus and hypertrichosis are reported in 80-99% and 6/7, respectively.

basis: Neurodevelopmental and skeletal defects define disease; oral/GI malformations 40-50%, tetralogy of Fallot 1/2. Stapes ankylosis and ptosis, each 1/2, omitted by cap; tiny cohorts.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: tetralogy of Fallot in 1/2 assessed; severe congenital cardiac damage takes priority under the four-organ cap.
decisions.otologic: none: stapes ankylosis in 1/2 supports involvement, but omitted under the cap in favor of defining organs, more widely documented GI defects and severe cardiac disease.

basis: Facial neuropathy, granulomatous orofacial inflammation and fissured tongue define disease; skin inflammation 80-99%. Unknown etiology does not establish an autoimmune or immune-mediated mechanism.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: defining granulomatous facial skin inflammation accompanies oral lesions; inflammatory skin abnormalities occur in 80-99%.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: granulomatous inflammation alone does not establish infection, immunodeficiency or an autoimmune/immune-mediated disease; etiology is unknown.

basis: Hypopigmentation, myelination defects/cerebellar atrophy and hepatomegaly in 2/2 define HOD; reduced visual acuity 1/2. Renal imaging changes do not establish functional damage.

decisions.renal: none: reduced corticomedullary differentiation in 1/2 is an imaging finding without established renal functional injury.
decisions.ocular: involved: reduced visual acuity documents visual loss in 1/2 reported patients; frequency meets threshold, with substantial small-cohort uncertainty.

basis: Spinal ligament ossification directly compresses cord/roots; clinical cohorts show myelopathy in roughly 30-40% over long follow-up. Associated diabetes is separate.

decisions.neurologic: involved: direct compressive cord/root injury; myelopathy affects approximately 30-40% over long follow-up in clinical cohorts, including patients symptomatic at presentation.

basis: Retroperitoneal soft tissue is outside the specified axes; mesenchymal lineage does not establish locomotor involvement, and invasion of adjacent organs is variable.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: retroperitoneal connective tissue is not connective tissue of the locomotor system; sarcoma histology alone does not establish this axis.

basis: Usually a localized cutaneous histiocytic proliferation; extracutaneous disease is uncommon. Tissue histiocyte lineage alone does not establish blood or marrow disease.

decisions.haematologic: none: localized tissue histiocyte proliferation does not establish a disease of circulating blood cells, marrow or coagulation.

basis: Inherited metabolic bone remodeling disease with characteristic deafness; optic atrophy 30-79%. Dental abnormalities lack documented dysfunction; hypertension is separately diagnosed.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: nonspecific dental abnormalities in 80-99% do not establish impaired dentition or oral function; the four-organ cap also prioritizes established damage.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hereditary hyperphosphatasia is an inherited metabolic bone disorder with profoundly dysregulated bone resorption and deposition.
decisions.otologic: primary: sensorineural hearing loss is a characteristic manifestation explicitly included in the disease definition, rather than an incidental complication.

basis: Congenital heart defects and developmental disability define disease; strabismus 3/7 (~43%). Clinodactyly 5/7 and hypermobility 3/7 do not establish locomotor damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: clinodactyly and joint laxity are common morphological findings, but disabling malformation, instability or other musculoskeletal functional injury is not established.

basis: Predominant classic OFD1 presentations have defining oral, digital and CNS malformations; cystic renal disease occurs in roughly 50%. Isolated retinal/airway presentations are minority subtypes.

decisions.renal: involved: cystic renal disease affects roughly 50% over time in the predominant classic OFD1 phenotype; renal involvement varies across rarer subtypes.
decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: oral malformations are defining features of the predominant classic orofaciodigital presentation; mouth and teeth belong to this axis.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: digital skeletal malformations define the predominant classic orofaciodigital presentation; isolated retinal and airway forms are minority subtypes.
